metadata.description: Claude Code plugin that routes reviews, tasks, and multi-model debates to Ollama, DeepSeek, MiniMax, and other OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints. Features 6 specialized AI personas, 5-harness execution (claude/codex/zero/kimi/cline), prompt shaping, and intelligent auto-routing.
